map.弹性解（对照，本页代码口径）：δ_el = P·L³ ÷ (48·E·I)（P: Elastic solution (reference, this page's code convention): δ_el = P·L³ ÷ (48·E·I) (P entered in kN and multiplied by 1000 to N; ×1000 to mm), with I taken from the input above (m⁴). RC long-term stiffness (GB 50010-2010, shown side by side with the elastic solution): M_q = P_q·L/4; first check M_q ≤ M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per 7.1.1 (W_0 = b·h²/6, kN·m) → if uncracked, B_s = E_c·I_0 and ψ is not applicable; if cracked, σ_s = M_q/(0.87·h₀·A_s), ψ = 1.1 − 0.65·f_tk/(ρ_te·σ_s) (clamped to 0.2–1.0), B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀²/[1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_E·ρ], θ = 2.0 − 0.4·min(1, ρ′/ρ) (7.2.5-1), B = B_s/θ (7.2.2-2), δ_lt = (1/12)·M_q·L²/B. Validation: an empty P, L, E or I triggers a prompt and aborts. Criterion: no fixed grading—the elastic deflection is proportional to the cube of the span and inversely proportional to the flexural rigidity EI; the RC deflection follows the quasi-permanent combination and long-term stiffness.
